summary: 3D physics mini-golf among the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia, built by Claude Fable 5.1 · Kapadokya peribacaları arasında gerçek fizikli 3D mini golf, Claude Fable 5.1 yaptı
key_features: 12 hand-designed holes, course par 40, from Pigeon Terrace to Sunrise Ridge
Real rolling physics: slopes, ramps, jumps, wall bounces and grass, sand and stone friction
Moving obstacles: a turning pottery wheel, a rolling stone door, swinging lanterns and a donkey
Three stars per hole (under par, a hidden grape, a trick shot); the ?auto bot finishes the course in 18 strokes
60 fps on Intel UHD 620 at 1280x720 with 16-22 draw calls; one index.html, optional CC0 asset pass

social.headline: Mini-golf among the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia: 12 holes, real physics, a pottery wheel and a donkey · Kapadokya peribacaları arasında mini golf: 12 delik, gerçek fizik, çömlek tezgâhı ve eşek
